title: RetailLens O2C
tagline: SAP S/4HANA order-to-cash analytics on 100K Olist orders
highlights: Mapped 98,353 real Olist e-commerce orders into SAP S/4HANA SD tables (VBAK/VBAP/LIKP/LIPS/BSAD) and a star schema of CDS-style SQL views.
Data-quality gates over 775,547 rows, quarantining 444 inconsistent records and logging 3,288 warnings with reasons.
SQL KPIs (CTEs, RANK, LAG): OTIF 92.9%, lead time 12.4 days, payment approval 10 hours, complaint rate 14.2%.
